The '''ring of shadows''' is a special [[ring]] that is obtained as a reward upon completion of [[Desert Treasure II]]. As an upgrade to the [[ring of visibility]], it retains its [[Ring of visibility#Uses|original effects]], as well as having very similar offensive stats to the [[brimstone ring]], making it a decent alternative. It cannot be equipped in the [[Lassar Undercity]].

The ring may be charged by using one [[Blood rune|blood]], [[Soul rune|soul]], [[Death rune|death]], and [[law rune]] on the ring. When charged, the ring can teleport players to the [[Ancient Vault]]; additional teleports to the [[Ghorrock Dungeon]], [[the Scar]], the [[Lassar Undercity]], and [[the Stranglewood]] can be unlocked by using tablets received as drops from [[Duke Sucellus]], [[The Leviathan]], [[The Whisperer]], and [[Vardorvis]] respectively on the ring. It may contain a maximum of 1,000 charges (costing {{NoCoins|({{GEP|Blood rune}} + {{GEP|Soul rune}} + {{GEP|Death rune}} + {{GEP|Law rune}}) * 1000|c}} to fully charge, or {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Blood rune}} + {{GEP|Soul rune}} + {{GEP|Death rune}} + {{GEP|Law rune}}|c}} per teleport). Players can configure the charges while the ring is in their bank by right-clicking on Configure-Charges, as long as players have the required materials.  Uncharging the ring ''does'' refund the runes.

If lost, another can be obtained from the [[Mysterious Bandit]] in the [[Ancient Vault]] for 75,000 coins. Multiple rings can be purchased from the bandit but they do not share charges.

Despite the ring's connections with Zaros' generals, it does '''not''' provide Zarosian [[God Wars Dungeon#God-related protection|god protection]] in the [[God Wars Dungeon]].

In PvP death, the ring turns into 75,000 coins regardless of Wilderness location. Any charges in the ring will be '''lost''' along with the ring itself.

The teleport to [[the Scar]] is the closest to a bank of the options on the ring, as the portal directly to the west of its location leads to the lobby for [[Guardians of the Rift|Guardians of the Rift.]]

==Uncharging==
The ring may only be uncharged if either the player has at least one empty inventory space or the player's inventory contains law runes, death runes, blood runes, and soul runes. If the player does not have enough empty inventory space for all four runes, the runes will be added into the player's inventory in the order of soul, blood, death, law. Any runes that are not able to fit into the inventory will be dropped to the ground.

==Trivia==
* If the ring is worn while entering the Lassar Undercity, it will be unequipped with the message, "''A strange magic rips your ring of shadows from your finger.''" If the player has no empty inventory spaces, they will be unable to enter the city and receive the message, "''As you go to climb down the rope, you feel a strange magic rejecting your ring of shadows.''" Attempting to equip the ring while in the city will yield the message, "''A strange magic prevents you from putting the ring on.''"
** Additionally, attempting to teleport there with the ring results in a chatbox message stating "'You will need one free space in your inventory as entering Lassar will unequip your ring.'"
